# agent-skills

> Portable Agent Skills (agentskills.io) for software-project best practices: project incubation, Python code review, CI/CD, PR readiness, and PostgreSQL review via MCPg. Claude Code plugin at version 0.13.0. Authoritative skill text lives in the GitHub repository; this site is the human documentation overview.

Important notes:

- Skills are host-agnostic routers under `skills/<name>/SKILL.md` with optional `references/` depth.
- Do not invent behaviour from this index alone — follow the linked SKILL.md and references.
- postgresql-review requires MCPg readiness and prefers read-only access; it suggests remediations and does not apply DDL by default.
- Documentation site: https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/
- Source repository: https://github.com/devopam/agent-skills

## Docs (this site)

- [Home](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/): Overview and skill table
- [Getting started](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/getting-started/): Install, plugin, invocation
- [Skills overview](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/): Index of five skills
- [project-incubation](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/project-incubation/): Inception and audit modes
- [python-code-review](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/python-code-review/): Eleven-domain scored Python review
- [ci-cd-plumber](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/ci-cd-plumber/): CI/CD scaffold and audit
- [pr-review](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/pr-review/): Pre-submit and PR readiness
- [postgresql-review](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/skills/postgresql-review/): Live Postgres review via MCPg
- [Evals](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/evals/): Hand-authored trust cases (51 in 0.13.0)
- [Contributing](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/contributing/): Authoring and research-before-authoring
- [Code of Conduct](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/code-of-conduct/): Contributor Covenant 3.0
- [Changelog](https://devopam.github.io/agent-skills/changelog/): Release history summary
